pick.name: Railway Hobby
pick.what: PaaS for containers, workers and DBs
pick.why: Simplest container DX: git push to a running service with databases, workers and cron alongside, from $5/mo
pick.free_limits: Free: $1/mo credit, NO custom domains, 1 project/3 services; Hobby $5/mo incl. $5 usage, 2 custom domains, 50 services

best_free.name: Cloudflare Workers (+ Durable Objects)
best_free.what: TypeScript/Python APIs and remote MCP servers at the edge
best_free.why: Free commercial tier, no cold starts, official remote-MCP template (Streamable HTTP) + Workers OAuth Provider for MCP auth
best_free.free_limits: 100k req/day, 10 ms CPU/invocation, 50 subrequests, 128 MB; Durable Objects free: 100k req/day, 13,000 GB-s/day, SQLite only; Paid $5/mo

alts.name: Google Cloud Run
alts.why: Best free option for Python/FastAPI, long requests or anything that breaks the Workers runtime
alts.free_limits: Request-based: 2M requests, 180,000 vCPU-s, 360,000 GiB-s per month (us-central1 basis; via Google locale pages, main page fetch truncated); needs billing account/card

alts.name: Fly.io pay-as-you-go
alts.why: Global micro-VMs; cheapest always-on container for small services
alts.free_limits: No free tier for new orgs (2 h runtime or 7-day trial); shared-cpu-1x 256 MB $2.19/mo, 1 GB $6.70/mo; dedicated IPv4 $2/mo

candidates.name: Cloudflare Workers
candidates.verdict: PICK: free + commercial, edge, first-class MCP template

candidates.name: Google Cloud Run
candidates.verdict: Alt: best free container runtime; card required

candidates.name: Railway Hobby
candidates.verdict: Alt: $5/mo, nicest DX, free tier has no custom domains

candidates.name: Render Free
candidates.verdict: Rejected for prod: docs say 'Do not use them for production', spin-down after 15 min, SMTP blocked

candidates.name: Fly.io
candidates.verdict: No free tier for new orgs (2h/7-day trial); $2.19/mo for 256 MB is cheap pay-later

candidates.name: Koyeb
candidates.verdict: Rejected: joining Mistral AI (announced 2026-02-17); new users can only sign up for paid plans

candidates.name: Deno Deploy / Netlify Functions
candidates.verdict: Viable but smaller ecosystems for MCP/agents than Workers

decision: Railway Hobby is the best overall for most small backends and MCP servers: containers, cron and databases with little ops. Cloudflare Workers is the best free option (commercial use allowed, no cold starts, official remote-MCP template). Move to Cloud Run for Python-heavy workloads, long requests or scale-to-zero billing.
details: Railway markets Hobby for solo developers/side projects and Pro ($20/workspace incl. $20 usage, unlimited seats) for production teams; Hobby has no stated commercial-use ban. Workers Free 10 ms CPU can be exceeded by password hashing or heavy SSR. Koyeb free tier closed (joining Mistral AI, announced 2026-02-17).

verify.note: Free $1 credit, 0 custom domains, 1 project/3 services; Hobby $5 incl. $5 usage, 2 custom domains, 50 projects/50 services, 7-day logs; Pro $20/workspace. No commercial restriction on Hobby, but Railway pitches Hobby at 'solo developers and side projects' and Pro at 'teams shipping to production'.
